role: independent verifier (separate metric, partition and selection code under roles/verifier/code/)
rules: append-only: a check entry is never edited or removed; every version is snapshotted to records/history/
kind NUMERICAL_REPLAY (own code recomputes a recorded number) and kind PROCEDURAL_COMPLIANCE (process and access evidence) are kept separate
a failing criterion is never widened; a genuine bug in a verifier check gets a separate correction in records/CHECK_CHANGES.json for adjudication by the coordinator
statuses: PASS, FAIL, ATTENTION (no failure of a registered criterion, but a discrepancy or caveat the coordinator must see), NOT_RUN
